segments.t: At the talent agency, IT specialist Nathan confirms that the leaked movie contract was photocopied in their own offices in the middle of the night. Andrea confronts Mathias over his maneuvers to take control of ASK. When Hicham Janowski suddenly offers to sell his shares, the corporate battle reaches an unexpected turning point. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Le contrat secret a été photocopié ici.
J'ai agi pour protéger notre agence.
Tu as trahi la confiance de tous.
Je veux seulement sauver notre avenir.
Cette situation devient totalement insupportable.
Nous devons rester unis aujourd'hui.
Tu as gagné, je quitte l'agence.
Je te vends mes parts maintenant.
J'accepte cette offre avec plaisir.
Ce soir, nous fêterons cette victoire.
J'annoncerai la nouvelle direction devant tous.
As-tu une solution pour les Américains?
Je sais exactement quoi faire.
Nous verrons bien ce soir.
Let's observe as Andrea, Mathias, and Hicham face off over the control of the agency.
Le contrat secret a été photocopié ici.
'The secret contract was photocopied here.' A direct declaration confirming internal corporate sabotage.
J'ai agi pour protéger notre agence.
'I acted to protect our agency.' A defensive justification framing calculated intrigue as loyalty.
Tu as trahi la confiance de tous.
'You betrayed everyone's trust.' A stern accusation condemning disloyalty toward colleagues.
Je veux seulement sauver notre avenir.
'I only want to save our future.' An emotional defense presenting personal ambition as corporate rescue.
Cette situation devient totalement insupportable.
'This situation is becoming completely unbearable.' An exhausted complaint reflecting mounting executive frustration.
Nous devons rester unis aujourd'hui.
'We must remain united today.' A diplomatic plea urging unity before the anniversary celebration.
Tu as gagné, je quitte l'agence.
'You won, I am leaving the agency.' A sudden surrender conceding defeat to a persistent rival.
Je te vends mes parts maintenant.
'I sell you my shares right now.' A decisive offer transferring agency ownership on the spot.
J'accepte cette offre avec plaisir.
'I accept this offer with pleasure.' A triumphal acceptance seizing the long-awaited opportunity.
Ce soir, nous fêterons cette victoire.
'Tonight, we will celebrate this victory.' An optimistic declaration linking the buyout to the anniversary party.
J'annoncerai la nouvelle direction devant tous.
'I will announce the new management before everyone.' A confident promise publicizing the leadership change.
As-tu une solution pour les Américains?
'Do you have a solution for the Americans?' A skeptical question challenging his plan for the costly lawsuit.
Je sais exactement quoi faire.
'I know exactly what to do.' A self-assured reply projecting complete mastery over the crisis.
Nous verrons bien ce soir.
'We shall see tonight.' A cautious concluding remark suspending belief until results appear. Now let's listen to the partners confronting each other again at full speed.

Cette situation devient totalement insupportable.
Nous devons rester unis aujourd'hui.
Tu as gagné, je quitte l'agence.
Je te vends mes parts maintenant.
J'accepte cette offre avec plaisir.
Ce soir, nous fêterons cette victoire.
J'annoncerai la nouvelle direction devant tous.
As-tu une solution pour les Américains?
Je sais exactement quoi faire.
Nous verrons bien ce soir.

With Hicham walking away and selling his shares, Mathias positions himself as the undisputed leader of ASK. Yet Andrea remains skeptical of his claims, wondering how he will handle the American studio's two million dollar claim.
La soirée sera décisive.
